Description: The training grounds echo with the clash of wooden swords and the grunts of weary guards.
Practice dummies line the wall, their straw guts spilling from too many battles fought in silence.
Banners flutter as if cheering on every strike, though they’ve seen better victories.
Axes, spears, and shields lie in wait — not for war, but for endless drills under the sun.
One guard mutters, 'If I break another dummy, can I go home early?'
Another replies, 'Only if the dummy beats you first… then maybe you’ll get a day off!'
